review.note: Rejected as written. This is not a product defect, so nothing returns to the fix loop as a defect. The intent is traced and wanted; re-propose with exact text: (a) group and id (next unused in J3 is J3.6) and surface cli; (b) full command lines for platform_mcp_info, career_catalogs_read and career_public_rollup_read with written fictional args (slug and displayKey values), and for each success one named field that must be present (for platform_mcp_info `transport` and `url`); (c) the error expectation as `isError: true` with `status` 404 and the `code` the product actually returns, in the J6.x wording; (d) for platform_capabilities_map, name the token. platform_capabilities_map needs the admin-only release.read scope, so a member cannot hold a token that reaches the role check; with TOKEN_A (no release.read) the refusal is the scope refusal J6.4 documents, so state that expected status and code explicitly. Observations for the integrator, not amendments (each needs its own proposal against the recounted registry): (1) J2.1 pins 96 tools for TOKEN_A, but the round 3 registry has 100 tools carrying career.read/career.write/outputs.approve (152 total) because platform_mcp_info, career_catalogs_read, career_public_rollup_read and career_site_metadata_sync were appended with those scopes, so J2.1 will fail on count and list until re-amended. (2) E.5 still says eleven tool names and is stale. (3) J11.2 pins 72 of 72 capabilities while docs/changes/platform-mcp.md reports 87 of 87 as of round 3.
